desc: a flapping host link (fix-flap, 19.6.7): from @200 the proxy holds a's packets for 7 s at a time, 0.2 s apart (ten half-open cuts, the last ending before the END's HOME barrier: a later one held a's barrier report past Instances:BarrierReportSeconds and split it). Each cut's 4 s of silence start a grace, each window a return; a's pads of the last ticks before each window come in time, so its fill streak ends every time and only the absence episode bounds it: every drop within Relay:LagLeaveSeconds of a return keeps the first grace's deadline, and the instance ends (host_lost) about 60 s after the first grace instead of never; b goes home
